trained_on: NHANES 1999-2010 with the 2019 public-use Linked Mortality Files
validation: temporal validation on NHANES 2011-2018 (17126 adults, 820 deaths): C-index 0.876 vs 0.833 for age and sex alone; US cohort, NOT validated in South Asia
notes: Trained by scripts/survival_experiment.py; re-run it to regenerate. Smoking is serum cotinine > 10 ng/mL (current smokers), so the form's 'current or former' box is scored as current. Alcohol shows the usual J-curve of survey data: non-drinkers carry slightly higher hazard than occasional drinkers, largely because people who have stopped drinking for health reasons are counted as non-drinkers. Reference profiles are training-set medians per sex and five-year age band; the arm compares against a peer measured on the same values only.
